changeSet.author: ${claude}
changeSet.comment: Per-user investment strategies and their classes (issue #518). A class carries a target percentage of its strategy; the seeded default strategy ("Sem estratégia") has a single default class ("Não definida") with no target, and neither can be renamed or removed.

rollback.sql: DROP TABLE finances.strategy_classes; DROP TABLE finances.strategies;

changeSet.author: ${claude}
changeSet.comment: Seed "Sem estratégia / Não definida" for every existing user and attach every holding to its owner's "Não definida". class_target_percentage is the holding's optional target in % of its class; a blank target shares what the typed targets of the class leave.

changeSet.author: ${claude}
changeSet.comment: Keep the defaults true for every insert path. A new user gets "Sem estratégia / Não definida", and a holding inserted without a class (wallet moves, reinvestments, sample data, tests) lands in its owner's "Não definida", so no caller has to know about strategies.

changeSet.author: ${claude}
changeSet.comment: Every holding with its kind, owner, class and typed class target, so strategy reads and the cross-kind holdings list resolve a holding's class through one relation.
changeSet.sql: CREATE VIEW finances.holding_strategy_classes AS SELECT 'STOCKS'::finances.wallet_kind AS kind, stock_holdings.id AS holding_id, stock_holdings.external_id AS holding_external_id, wallets.user_id, stock_holdings.strategy_class_id, stock_holdings.class_target_percentage FROM finances.stock_holdings JOIN finances.wallets ON wallets.id = stock_holdings.wallet_id UNION ALL SELECT 'CRYPTO'::finances.wallet_kind, crypto_holdings.id, crypto_holdings.external_id, wallets.user_id, crypto_holdings.strategy_class_id, crypto_holdings.class_target_percentage FROM finances.crypto_holdings JOIN finances.wallets ON wallets.id = crypto_holdings.wallet_id UNION ALL SELECT 'FUNDS'::finances.wallet_kind, fund_holdings.id, fund_holdings.external_id, wallets.user_id, fund_holdings.strategy_class_id, fund_holdings.class_target_percentage FROM finances.fund_holdings JOIN finances.wallets ON wallets.id = fund_holdings.wallet_id;
